name: Kadmos Capital
identity_check: Confirmed as Kadmos Capital (kadmoscapital.com), the London early-stage deep-tech VC. Portfolio press releases name the firm, link www.kadmoscapital.com and describe it as 'an FCA regulated venture capital firm based in London'. The management company is KADMOS CAPITAL LTD (Companies House 13453306, incorporated 14 June 2021; directors Remy Kesrouani and Jean Gebeily; registered at Fora United House, 9 Pembridge Road, London W11 3JY). Kadmos Capital I LP, Kadmos Capital GP I LLP, Kadmos Stability LP, Kadmos Co-Invest GP LLP and Kadmos BioDiscovery I LP share that address, and/or have Kadmos Capital Ltd and the same two people as members. Ruled out: 'Kadmos', a separate startup whose own $9M seed (Jan 2022) and Series A show up in search results under that name (a fundraising company, not this investor), and unrelated UK companies on the Companies House list (Kadmos Ltd, Kadmos Consultants, Kadmos Engineering, Kadmos Networks, Kadmosto). Some round articles write only 'Kadmos'. The firm's own site loads all its content by script, so its text (team, portfolio, contact) could not be read; only its meta description was readable.

open_items: kadmoscapital.com loads all its text (team, portfolio, contact, social links) by script; only the meta description could be read. So application_url, the company LinkedIn URL, a reported portfolio count and partner profile links were not found, and accepts_cold_inbound is 'unknown'.
Check size not stated on any primary or press page. Hopohopo (database) gives a 'first ticket' of £2.5M to £24M, which looks implausible for a seed fund and was not recorded.

Fund sizes and close dates unknown for all three PFLPs: Kadmos Capital I LP (registered 28 Jan 2022), Kadmos Stability LP (17 Feb 2026) and Kadmos BioDiscovery I LP (11 Aug 2026). Registration dates are not close dates. Hopohopo (database) says Kadmos Capital I is backed by Nour Nouf Ventures; not confirmed. The FCA register entry was not checked.

Kadmos Stability LP may be a deal-specific co-investment vehicle rather than a fund: its general partner, first named Kadmos Stability GP LLP, was renamed Kadmos Co-Invest GP LLP (Companies House). What it invests in is not published. Kadmos BioDiscovery I LP (Aug 2026) suggests a new biotech-focused vehicle; no announcement found.

Other people seen only on databases or filings, not recorded as partners: Laurence Holloway (Senior Partner) and Aimee Bryce (Venture Associate) per Hopohopo; Graham York, designated member of Kadmos Capital GP I LLP from Mar 2023 until he resigned on 31 Dec 2025 (Companies House).

invests_in_indian_founders: not stated. requires_us_entity: 'unknown'. The firm calls itself UK-based and pan-European, and its portfolio is UK, Swiss, French and US (Pathway), so a US entity is evidently not required, but no page says so.

No deal in industrial, robotics or hardware was found. The portfolio seen is AI infrastructure and apps, techbio and health, plus sustainable materials and chemistry (Scindo, Arda Biomaterials). The 'physical AI' Phase 1 category looks like a weak fit.

Rounds not recorded (outside 24 months or unverified on a round page): Jua (Feb 2024), GlycanAge seed (Feb 2024; co-led with LAUNCHub per CB Insights), Xonai seed (Jun 2023), iFast Diagnostics and cheMastery (Angels Partners listing), and Antiverse's earlier rounds. AgFunderNews, Biofuels Digest, BusinessWire, Nordic9, Seedtable and F4 pages returned 403 or 429.
Arda Biomaterials (London, barley-protein materials) is not Arda Industries (arda.ai, cache/arda.json). Keep them separate when merging.
Pathway's 2026 extension comes from one page (The SaaS News, citing Dealroom). Whether the $500M valuation is pre- or post-money is not stated, so valuation_post_original is null.
